headline: Death Aspect overwhelms the table with The Capitoline Triad’s 9/9 emblem

result.summary: Death Aspect survives the midgame, resolves Living Death and The Capitoline Triad, eliminates Borrowed Time on turn 8, then attacks Sin-fall for lethal on turn 9.
